what: GE Vernova makes the equipment that generates and moves electricity: gas turbines, wind turbines, and grid gear such as transformers and switchgear. It was spun out of General Electric in 2024.
customers: Utilities, power producers and grid operators worldwide.
money: gas turbines and their long-term servicing, steam and nuclear
moat: A huge installed base of gas turbines that needs decades of service, and scarce capacity in turbines and grid equipment.
risks: Power demand from data centres slowing
Execution on a large order backlog
